name: Marching Slices with Slab-based Caching
definition: The algorithm uses slice caches storing cube-done flags to prevent revisiting processed cubes in the current slab and to prevent adding already processed cubes to the todo list of adjacent slabs.
summary: Marching Slices with Slab-based Caching is a memory-efficient isosurface extraction algorithm that processes volumes in slabs using slice caches to ensure geometric continuity while significantly reducing memory usage compared to traditional marching cubes.
